name: Orsen & Lowe Wholecut Derby
description: A single-piece upper derby in charcoal grey, cut from one panel of bonded synth-hide with no visible seams except at the heel. The silhouette is clean and slightly elongated. Orsen & Lowe is a mid-market brand that punches above its price — the kind of shoe that gets noticed by people who notice shoes.
functionality: Pressure-balanced cork footbed. No active tech.
what_it_says: You have an eye for quality and you don't need to explain it to anyone.
story_hooks: Orsen & Lowe recently lost their primary synth-hide supplier — authentic pairs are quietly becoming collectible.
A character wearing these in the Shelf immediately draws attention — they clearly don't belong.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, minimalist derby with an almost futuristic sensibility — the seamless upper reads as a single sculptural form in soft charcoal grey. The silhouette is slightly elongated and refined, suggesting Tier 2-3 aspirational styling without ostentation. Wears with quiet confidence.
physical_description.fit: Precise and tailored through the vamp and quarters, with a natural arch support and a gently tapered toe box. Not aggressive, but deliberately proportioned to flatter the foot's geometry.
physical_description.primary_material: Bonded synth-hide — a durable, ethically-sourced composite that mimics premium leather with superior durability and thermal regulation for urban climates.
physical_description.texture: Smooth with a subtle matte finish; the bonded surface has a faint organic texture that catches light subtly without shine. No grain pattern — uniformly refined.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal grey as primary; darker charcoal stitching at the heel seam; black rubber sole with subtle grey edging.
physical_description.closures: Traditional lacing system with metal eyelets; laces appear to be synth-cord in matching charcoal.
distinctive_features: Single-piece upper construction — extraordinary manufacturing feat visible only to those who know what to look for
Heel seam is the only visible stitching, creating an almost unbroken visual line
Orsen & Lowe signature minimal branding on tongue
Reinforced heel counter for posture support
Integrated microcirculation thermal lining (invisible, high-end feature)
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 bridge wear — expensive enough to signal taste and income, accessible enough to not scream corpo excess
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by mid-level corporate professionals, independent contractors, data analysts, and style-conscious working-class urbanites. The kind of person who reads fashion criticism in their neural feed.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to lightly worn; shows minimal creasing due to the bonded material's rigidity; maintains appearance even with heavy use

image_prompt: A charcoal grey seamless derby shoe displayed on a sleek matte-black mannequin foot, angled three-quarter view to emphasize the single-piece upper construction. Moody studio lighting with cool blue-white highlights raking across the synth-hide surface, casting subtle shadows that emphasize the refined contours. Dark concrete floor with faint neon reflection. Minimal styling — clean, corporate, cyberpunk-minimalist. High contrast background. Close enough to show craftsmanship details, far enough to see the full silhouette. Professional fashion photography, luxury catalog aesthetic. --ar 2:3 --v 6
